description: 5 scenarios testing multi-tool and multi-agent dependency chains where output from one tool must be correctly passed as input to the next. Tests context preservation across tool boundaries.

scenarios.title: Check PO status then notify vendor
scenarios.prompt: Check the status of PO-7890 and then notify the vendor with the result.

expected_routing.notes: Chain: SAP → Vendor Portal (to get vendor contact) → Email (with PO status from SAP). Each tool output feeds the next. Email must contain actual PO status, not a placeholder.

failure_modes: Notifies vendor with empty or generic message instead of actual PO status
Skips vendor portal lookup — sends to wrong contact
Sends email before PO status is retrieved
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Vendor confusion from incorrect status notification; damaged supplier relationship.

scenarios.title: Process invoice, post to GL, then create accrual
scenarios.prompt: Process invoice INV-2024-0456, post the GL entry, and create the month-end accrual.

expected_routing.notes: Chain: Invoice Processing (validates invoice, returns GL data) → GL Posting (uses invoice GL codes) → Accrual Creation (uses GL posting reference). Each step must complete before the next.

failure_modes: Posts GL without waiting for invoice validation
Creates accrual without GL posting reference
Passes wrong GL account from invoice to posting tool
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Accounting period error; unreconciled GL entries; SOX audit finding.

scenarios.title: Line down: check materials, then dispatch maintenance
scenarios.prompt: Line 4 at Plant 2 is down. Check material availability and dispatch maintenance.

expected_routing.notes: Chain: Line Status (confirms down state, identifies failure type) → Inventory Check (checks materials needed for repair identified in step 1) → Maintenance Dispatch (with failure type + materials context).

failure_modes: Dispatches maintenance without knowing what failed
Checks generic inventory, not materials relevant to the specific failure
Dispatches wrong maintenance crew for the identified failure type
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Extended downtime from wrong repair crew; OEE degradation; missed production target.

scenarios.title: Incident update, root cause analysis, then stakeholder notification
scenarios.prompt: Update incident INC-8821, analyze root cause, and notify all affected stakeholders.

expected_routing.notes: Chain: Incident Tool (fetches incident details, updates status) → RCA Tool (uses incident details to perform analysis) → Notification Tool (sends to stakeholders from incident record with RCA summary).

expected_clarification: Target stakeholders or auto-detect from incident record
failure_modes: Notifies stakeholders before RCA is complete
RCA performed without incident details — generic analysis
Stakeholder list not pulled from incident record
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Premature notification with incomplete information; customer trust loss.

scenarios.title: Budget approval, PO creation, vendor confirmation
scenarios.prompt: Get budget approval for $45,000, create the purchase order, and confirm with the vendor.

expected_routing.notes: Chain: Budget Approval (returns approval reference) → PO Creation (embeds approval reference in PO) → Vendor Confirmation (sends PO number from step 2 to vendor). Must not skip budget approval step.

failure_modes: Creates PO before budget approval is obtained
PO created without embedding budget approval reference
Vendor confirmation sent without PO number
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Unauthorized spend; PO missing approval reference rejected by finance; vendor fulfills without confirmed PO.
